info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Streaming Subscriptions Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Streaming Subscriptions API allows clients to cancel active streaming subscriptions within the system. This endpoint is particularly useful for users who wish to discontinue their subscriptions or manage their streaming services effectively. Typically, content providers or platform operators use this functionality to ensure that only desired subscriptions are maintained. By providing a straightforward method to cancel subscriptions, the API helps maintain a seamless user experience and support account management tasks.

delete.description: This operation allows the user to cancel an active subscription. Once canceled, the subscription will no longer be active, and no further charges will be applied.

requestBody.description: Request body for cancelling a subscription. This payload should include the necessary details required to identify and process the cancellation request.

200.description: The subscription cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelReques.description: The JSON string representation of the request body for canceling a subscription.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelRespon.title: Cancel Subscription Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancel operation was successful or not.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the cancellation operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation process.

state.description: Current state of the subscription after the cancellation attempt.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelRespon.description: Response object returned after canceling a subscription.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation request was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Details related to the audit of the cancel operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
